What is Cash & Miles?

With Cash & Miles, Miles & More members can redeem their miles in part or in full for flights at lufthansa.com. This option is available for all travel classes. The fare is calculated based on the total ticket price, including taxes, fees, and surcharges. {column-end}

FAQs about Cash & Miles

Why is the Cash & Miles option not being displayed?
There may be several reasons for this. Perhaps you have not yet signed into lufthansa.com with your login details, or you have not yet reached the required mileage amount of at least 3,000 miles. Also, Cash & Miles is not yet available in all markets.
Which services (flights, taxes, fees, and surcharges, or upgrades) can I pay for using Cash & Miles?
With Cash & Miles you can redeem your miles for the cost of your flight booking in part or in full. This option is available for all travel classes. The fare is calculated based on the total ticket price, including taxes, fees, and surcharges. Cash & Miles cannot be used to purchase upgrades. Upgrades can be purchased as usual by booking an upgrade directly via Miles & More at www.miles-and-more.com.
